messages.author: a35be9b95ff16b80
messages.subject: Deploy problem: Application depends on package "RcppArmadillo" but it is not installed.
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to deploy a shiny app into shinyapps.io, but I get the following error from RStudio: 

"Application depends on package "RcppArmadillo" but it is not installed."

I'm using the library(forecast) within my shiny app, and I'm not sure how to solve this problem. Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploy problem: Application depends on package "RcppArmadillo" but it is not installed.
parts:
Have you tired installing the "RcppArmadillo" package?

install.packages('RcppArmadillo')

-Andy
